repositories.name: Meta_OpenEnv
repositories.description: OpenEnv-compatible environment where an RL or LLM agent triages assignments and production bugs against deadlines and a burnout budget. FastAPI server, deterministic graders, 110-test suite in CI.

repositories.name: Shopkart
repositories.description: Full-stack e-commerce app: JWT auth, catalog, wishlist, cart, server-side checkout and Razorpay payments. React + Express + MongoDB, deployed on Vercel.

repositories.name: codecrafters-shell-cpp
repositories.description: POSIX-style shell in C++23: builtins, PATH lookup, quoting, I/O redirection, multi-stage pipelines and background jobs on fork/exec/pipe/dup2.

repositories.name: Vidya
repositories.description: React Native book discovery app: Google Books search with debounced infinite scroll, Firebase email and Google sign-in, and saved lists with Redux Toolkit + redux-persist.

repositories.name: Fintrac
repositories.description: Personal finance tracker and budgeting dashboard with Gemini-powered spending analysis. React + Vite + Recharts.

repositories.name: Naukri
repositories.description: Dark-mode job portal UI in React + Vite with API-backed listings and saved jobs, deployed on GitHub Pages.

repositories.name: LexGuard
repositories.description: AI contract review for Indian law: clause-level risk ratings, plain-language explanations, statute-grounded citations and fairer rewrites. Multi-agent LLM pipeline with a deterministic safety net.

repositories.name: Pikina
repositories.description: Offline-first personal operating layer for Windows: deterministic intent routing with a local Ollama fallback, DAG task scheduler, transactional executor with rollback, and a consent gate for OS actions.

repositories.name: Noesis
repositories.description: Multimodal RAG over video, audio, PDFs and images: Whisper transcription, local OCR, hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with reranking, and grounded answers that show their sources. Streamlit UI with a knowledge graph.

repositories.name: Resilion
repositories.description: Energy supply-chain risk intelligence: two AI agents over a NetworkX knowledge graph turn geopolitical news (GDELT, RSS) into disruption events and rank alternative crude routes, with human sign-off on every action.
